name: Render a Vega-Lite chart to SVG
summary: Send a Vega-Lite v5 chart specification, get back byte-reproducible SVG and its SHA-256; the same request always returns the same bytes.

determinism.evidence: README of the service: byte-identical renders in one process, concurrently, and across processes under different TZ/LANG/LC_ALL; golden hashes per figure. Re-verified for this contract by rendering the example twice (identical bytes, same sha256).

data.description: Either an array of rows (inline data for a spec with no top-level data) or a map of root-relative path to file text (or JSON value) that the spec's data.url values resolve to.

baseUrl.description: Root-relative directory the spec's relative urls are resolved against. Default: the root.

spec.title: Requests served by outcome
spec.description: Bar chart of requests served and refused by a service in one week.

clauses.says: the JSON request body is at most 256 KiB
the request is an object with a Vega-Lite v5 spec that compiles, with no network, absolute or escaping data urls

capacity.reason: Renders set process.env.TZ and reseed Vega's random source, so they run one at a time in one process.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of svg.

guarantees.says: the result is an svg, its sha256, its byte length and the compiler warnings
sha256 is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of svg
the svg is at most 4 MiB

refusals.says: No payment was presented. The response carries the exact payment requirements; nothing has been computed.
The presented payment did not verify or did not settle. Nothing was charged and no result is returned.
The service's queue is full. Retry later; nothing was charged.
The request waited longer than the queue allows. Retry later; nothing was charged.
The service failed on an input that met the precondition. Nothing was charged.
The service did not finish within its run limit. Nothing was charged.
This service is held and not for sale. Nothing was charged.
The quoted price does not cover the stated cost, so the sale is refused. Nothing was charged.
The request body exceeds 256 KiB. Nothing was charged.
The request is not a valid chart request: malformed, a spec that does not compile, or a data url that is a network, absolute or escaping reference. Nothing was charged.
The result did not have the promised shape and was withheld. Nothing was charged.
The result's digest did not match its svg and was withheld. Nothing was charged.
The rendered svg exceeds 4 MiB and was withheld. Nothing was charged.

cost.evidence: CPU 55 ms per warm render measured 2026-10-24 on the development host under heavy load (upper bound), priced at an ASSUMED USD 0.0001 per CPU-second. settlementFeeAtomic 1000 is an ASSUMPTION (about USD 0.001 per CDP-facilitated settlement) the owner has not confirmed; replace both with observed values before enabling the sale.

framings.title: Render a Vega-Lite chart to SVG
framings.description: Render a Vega-Lite v5 chart specification to SVG. Headless and offline, text stays text, accessible title and description, and the same request always returns the same bytes plus their SHA-256.
